description: Ministry of Lands - Transfer of a Portion of Land in Ambanawatta in Gampaha District in the Road Development Authority
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land-related matters, specifically the alienation (sale) of agricultural land from the Land Reforms Commission to the Road Development Authority. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, including their location, boundaries, survey plans, and monetary consideration. The content focuses entirely on land transfer and property matters, fitting the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative actions. While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the core land transaction being documented.
